annotation.bound_parties_text: The Decree binds the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, heads of relevant central administrative agencies, and heads of local governments (mayors/governors) applying for drone zones and parks.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The head of a relevant administrative agency, upon receipt of the guidelines for preparation, shall prepare sectoral plans for fields under his or her jurisdiction and submit them the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.
annotation.dates_quote: This Decree shall enter into force on May 1, 2020.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON PROMOTION OF UTILIZATION OF DRONES AND CREATION OF INFRASTRUCTURE THEREFOR
